description: The numbers of one of the user's meetings, from its transcript timings: each speaker's share of the talk time, the longest anyone spoke without someone else speaking, questions asked per person, and who made each decision the user kept. If the meeting is part of a series (same title or same people), also the user's talk share and kept decisions over its last 8 meetings, and the series' health over them: time, decisions, commitments made and closed, questions answered, each per meeting-hour, and from 4 meetings one suggestion (keep, shorten, go async, add a decider, end it) with its reason; and the stuck topics it discussed: subjects 3 meetings in 30 days discussed without a decision, each with its meetings' lines and the options named so far. Numbers only: never present them as a judgment of anyone.
name: meeting_dynamics
